shorts_extract.hook: Why 10,000 glances at a penny leave zero memory while 0.5 seconds of meaning locks a word in at 82%: Craik & Lockhart's Levels of Processing.

shorts_extract.twist: Why slow vowel-counting still loses to fast meaning (Exp. 5), Transfer-Appropriate Processing (1977), and 1998 Subsequent-Memory fMRI.
